title: The Sigil of the Sundered Sea Revisited
author: Astrid Ishikawa
blurb: Casper Amberdale, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
